Consent→Tab→Refresh native keyboard focus and visible outline; Refresh not activated
Persistent missing-metadata hint in actual 1440px and 390px DOM and screenshots; native disabled Test
DOM/reload/localStorage/sessionStorage/URLs/console contain neither synthetic secret nor pairing code; no raw body/header logs retained
Real logout204→session401→reload pairing UI; private Settings removed; no repeat write
No model-test PUT, metadata POST or browser off-origin attempt; server cache census performed separately
Read-only owned schema0015 counts+hashes for model record/command/dispatch/event unchanged
